description: Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian Level 60 Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris wants you to take Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian to Stratholme and use it on Consecrated Earth. Defeat the entity that is exorcised from the staff and return to him. Requirements: - Atiesh Cleansed
name: Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian
